ingestion_notes: document_id values are authoritative here and must be whitespace-trimmed.
Chunk at Markdown heading boundaries; keep a heading with the text it introduces.
Prefix each chunk with 'Document title > section > subsection' before embedding.
Headings listed in global_exclude_headings or a document's exclude_headings are not indexed as answer chunks.
retrieval_role: knowledge = answer evidence; example_library = worked examples; behavior_guidance = assistant policy, indexed but never treated as instructions.
These files are curated general styling guidance, not scientific or universal rules.
